semantic_model.state_mapping: A two-ply macro maps each q/game state to a family of opponent-possible successor sets, one set per current-player action.
semantic_model.threshold_semantics: A threshold holds iff there exists one action outcome-set entirely contained in the target threshold region.
semantic_model.closure_observation: Up-closing or union-closing the outcome-set family does not change this existential/universal threshold semantics; supersets are weaker current-player choices.
semantic_model.literature: Up-closed multirelations support associative Parikh composition; union-closed multirelations support associative Peleg composition.

interpretation: Connect4 two-ply game macros fit the alternating multirelation / monotone predicate-transformer semantics from the literature.
Associative closure is available after semantically harmless up/union closure.
The inclusion-minimal outcome-set antichain is not a compact RBA representation: it can explode to 1024 sets at the empty 4x3 root after only four plies.
Applying the four-front value abstraction during composition is therefore essential; composing the raw multirelation first and abstracting afterward preserves too much strategy-outcome detail.
The RBA mixed-cover operation can be understood as the abstract image of multirelational choice-function composition under the value-boundary abstraction.
